heirloom.loading.tt.1.t1: Remember to explore the area while trying to survive. Each map contains
heirloom.loading.tt.1.t2: hidden chests that will have special items inside.
heirloom.loading.tt.2.t1: At the start of the round there is a Grace Period where all players are
heirloom.loading.tt.2.t2: invulnerable. Use this time wisely to plan your first move.
heirloom.loading.tt.3.t1: Towards the end of a round, a Showdown will occur. During a Showdown,
heirloom.loading.tt.3.t2: Online ID's are visible to everyone. Will you run or fight?
heirloom.loading.tt.4.t1: You died! You can spectate the surviving players until the next round.
heirloom.loading.tt.4.t2: You can fly around or follow other players by pressing Attack.
heirloom.loading.tt.5.t1: Remember that there are different ways to win. Maybe you could try hiding,
heirloom.loading.tt.5.t2: hoarding equipment or teaming up with other players.
heirloom.loading.tt.6.t1: Whenever you pick up a type of armor you aren't already wearing,
heirloom.loading.tt.7.t1: Your hotbar now refills with new items from your inventory if there are
heirloom.loading.tt.7.t2: empty slots. Try dropping items you don't want when your hotbar is full.
heirloom.loading.tt.8.t1: The last surviving player is the winner. Defeating other players will
heirloom.loading.tt.8.t2: improve your chances, but you must be the last survivor to be victorious.
heirloom.loading.tt.9.t1: Actions like swimming, jumping and running cause your hunger bar to
heirloom.loading.tt.9.t2: deplete more. Make sure you always have some food on you!
heirloom.loading.tt.10.t1: You will still regenerate health with a low hunger level, however this
heirloom.loading.tt.10.t2: will cause your hunger bar to deplete quickly while healing!
